name: DCM Shriram Ltd
about: DCM Shriram is engaged in the business of manufacturing facilities of Fertiliser, Chloro Vinyl & Cement in Kota (Rajasthan) and of Chlor- Alkali in Bharuch (Gujrat).(Source : Company Web-site )
keyPoints:
Business Segments
1) Sugar (35% in 9M FY25 vs 26% in FY23): [1] [2] The company is a major player in the domestic sugar industry having 4 integrated sugar complexes located in central UP at Ajbapur, Hariawan, Loni, and Rupapur with a total crushing capacity of 42,400 TCD. It also operates 3 distilleries with 560 KLD capacity. [3]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 23.5%
cons: Stock is trading at 2.57 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.23% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.97% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
